verdict.rationale: PostHog AI is documented as an in-product analyst that answers plain-English questions over your data, builds insights, and explains what it found. Self-driving surfaces pattern-based reports and suggested fixes, and Replay Vision turns recordings into AI observations such as frustration scores and session summaries. One hands-on user report confirms the in-product LLM exists but describes a capability gap (it would not create a cohort from SQL) and severe UI slowdown. missing for 10: independent corroboration of insight quality and accuracy, evidence the in-product AI performs reliably without the reported capability gaps and slowdown.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: PostHog AI is an AI product analyst that lives inside PostHog. Ask it a question in plain English and it queries your data, builds the insight, writes the SQL, or finds the session replay – then explains what it found.
It watches how people actually use your product, finds what's worth fixing, opens a pull request, and measures whether the change worked.
Replay Vision uses AI to automatically watch your session recordings and turn what it sees into structured, queryable data.
PostHog spots the pattern in your data, drafts a fix, and opens a pull request for you to review.
